description: Fetches King of Fighters boss character profiles and move lists from arcadequartermaster.com, including character stats, special moves, and striker data.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - fetch_boss_page: 从指定URL获取单个KOF游戏的角色数据; 参数: url; 必填: url
  - fetch_all_pages: 获取所有已知KOF boss页面的数据; 参数: 无; 必填: 无

url.description: 要获取的页面URL (fetch_boss_page需要，必须是arcadequartermaster.com域名)
